arguments.sql:
SELECT c.watermark, c.types, f.language,
       COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS card_count
FROM main.cards AS c
JOIN main.foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE LOWER(c.watermark) = 'boros'
GROUP BY c.watermark, c.types, f.language
ORDER BY c.watermark, c.types, f.language

arguments.sql:
WITH type_counts AS (
    SELECT c.types AS card_type, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM main.cards AS c
    WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
      AND c.uuid IN (
          SELECT f.uuid
          FROM main.foreign_data AS f
          WHERE f.language <> 'English'
      )
    GROUP BY c.types
)
SELECT card_type, card_count
FROM type_counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM type_counts)
ORDER BY card_type
